display.purpose: Page headlines and large current-value figures (e.g. current weight in kg). Sentence case, not tracked.

label.purpose: The .tracked utility: region numerals/titles, meta text, field labels, button text, tab labels — always uppercase, always 0.14em letter-spacing.

body.purpose: All running text, list rows, form values, chart tooltips.

motion.name: transition-standard
motion.purpose: Button/link/tab hover and focus-border transitions; no custom easing curve observed in the build.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The system's only button variant: low-fill, bordered, tracked label text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid rgba(111,168,179,0.5); background: rgba(167,230,238,0.1); color: #a7e6ee; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 0; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: #a7e6ee; background: rgba(167,230,238,0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid #a7e6ee; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Square-cornered field on a darker-than-panel fill, tracked Cinzel label above.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; font-size: 0.65rem; color: #9ba5b4; } .ds-input { border-radius: 0; border: 1px solid rgba(226,232,240,0.11); background: rgba(49,56,66,0.6); padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #e6ebf2; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9ba5b4; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #6fa8b3; outline: none; }

components.name: Region Panel
components.description: The core container: hairline-bordered, header/body/footer strips, no radius, no shadow.
components.html:
II · Poids

Contenu de la région.
components.css: .ds-region-panel { border: 1px solid rgba(226,232,240,0.11); background: rgba(55,63,75,0.6); } .ds-region-header { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(226,232,240,0.11); padding: 16px 24px; } .ds-region-title { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #9ba5b4; } .ds-region-body { padding: 24px; color: #e6ebf2; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Mist Region (unsurveyed placeholder)
components.description: Signature honesty device: a dashed-border placeholder for a region with no data yet, instead of a fake empty state.
components.html:
IV · Quêtes

Région sous la brume

Pas encore cartographiée.
components.css: .ds-mist-region { border: 1px dashed rgba(226,232,240,0.11); padding: 32px 24px; text-align: center; } .ds-mist-title { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #9ba5b4; } .ds-mist-tag { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; margin-top: 12px; font-size: 1.125rem; color: #9ba5b4; } .ds-mist-note { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #9ba5b4; max-width: 24rem; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; }

components.name: Sealed Region Badge
components.description: Double-ring numeral seal marking a completed region; the system's only circular, status-bearing shape (replaced a flat badge draft during finish review).
components.css: .ds-seal-outer { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(111,168,179,0.6); padding: 2px; } .ds-seal-inner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px dashed rgba(111,168,179,0.5); font-size: 0.55rem; color: #a7e6ee; }

components.name: Period Filter Tabs
components.description: Hairline-bordered tab row for chart period selection; active tab gets a cyan bottom border and cyan text, no fill.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-tab { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; font-size: 0.65rem; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; color: #9ba5b4; transition: color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #e6ebf2; } .ds-tab-active { border-color: #6fa8b3; color: #a7e6ee; }

narrative.overview: Geekoach reads as a hand-surveyed map, not a fitness dashboard. The world is a patinated slate-blue field, engraved with thin hairlines rather than boxed cards, where a single pale-cyan halo stands in for a lamp held over unfinished territory. Regions of the map — Profil, Poids, Séances, Quêtes, Coach — are either surveyed (rendered with real data and a hairline border) or still under mist (rendered as a dashed-border placeholder with muted, honest language: "Région sous la brume"). Nothing fakes completion; an unsurveyed region says so. Typography carries the cartographer voice: Cinzel in tight, wide-spaced small caps for numerals, region titles, and labels (the ink of hand-lettered map legends), Inter for every sentence of running text and data (legible, modern, never decorative). The pairing is deliberately asymmetric — display/label is ornamental and rare, body is plain and load-bearing. The system rejects near-black "app" darkness (the comp and the shipped build both land on a lived-in slate-blue, #313842, not #0a0a0a) and rejects dashboard chrome — no card-shadow elevation, no icon-driven nav, no colored status chips. Depth comes from a single radial cyan glow at the top of the page and from border hairlines at two opacities, never from shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Slate-blue ink field with a single pale-cyan accent, used sparingly (links, active states, chart line, focus rings)
Cinzel small-caps for all labels/numerals/headings; Inter for all body and data
Regions are hairline-bordered panels or dashed-border "mist" placeholders — never rounded cards
Sharp corners everywhere (border-radius: 0); the only circular forms are the sealed-region badge and the scrollbar thumb
A numbered seal (double-ring, roman numeral) marks a region as complete, not a checkmark or a colored badge

rules.name: The One Halo Rule
rules.body: Color is scarce: cyan appears only as accent (line, link, active state, focus ring, seal), never as a background fill. Every surface is slate-blue-on-slate-blue; the accent's rarity is what makes it read as a lamp, not a UI color.

rules.name: The Tracked-Label Rule
rules.body: Any Cinzel usage below headline size is always uppercase, always letter-spaced at 0.14em via the shared .tracked class — never a bare small caption. Small text is either plain Inter body copy or a tracked Cinzel label; there is no intermediate style.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. Separation between surfaces is drawn with a hairline border or a translucent background tint, never box-shadow. This is a hairline-and-glow world, not a lifted-card world.

dos: Do keep every corner square (border-radius: 0) except the sealed-region badge and the scrollbar thumb, which are the system's only confirmed circular forms.
Do reserve cyan for accent roles only (line, link, active tab, focus ring, chart line, seal) — never as a panel or button fill above 20% opacity.
Do render an unsurveyed region as a dashed-border "mist" placeholder with plain language about what's missing, rather than an empty chart or a fabricated zero-state metric.
Do pair every Cinzel usage with the tracked/uppercase/0.14em treatment; Inter carries all sentence-case text.
Do use the double-ring numeral badge for "sealed/complete" states; it is the system's one status-indicator shape.
donts: Don't add box-shadows or lifted-card elevation; depth comes only from the single radial glow and the two-step hairline border system.

Don't introduce kicker/eyebrow labels above headings — the craft floor bans this device project-wide, and it was removed from this build during finish review; it is not a pattern to revive on future surfaces.
Don't darken the page ground toward near-black; the slate-blue ink (#313842) is the confirmed ground color, corrected up from an earlier near-black draft to match the approved comp.
Don't use a filled/solid button; every button in the system is the low-fill bordered treatment (bg-cyan/10 at rest).
Don't invent a colored status chip or badge for "complete" states; use the double-ring seal instead.
